title: Under Your Feet
subtitle: Queen's Park and the lost Taddle Creek
theme: A buried creek shaped this park, the campus and the path you'll walk at the end.
intro: Start at the pink sandstone legislature; the thread is Taddle Creek, a stream that was buried under the park and campus.
outro: End at the ROM: the creek's old valley is the dip of Philosopher's Walk you just climbed out of.
